title: Open Values Presentation Source Index v1.0
description: Records for the sources that have their own page on the site, each with its publisher, dates, scope, limits and the catalogue facts that cite it. Maintainers write it, and the presentation build checks that every listed fact really cites the source's address.

format.description: Names the file format. Always open-values-presentation-source-index.

version.description: The version of this format the file follows. Always 1.0.0.

updated.description: The date the index was last changed, as YYYY-MM-DD.

scope.description: A sentence saying which sources the index covers and what happens to sources outside it.

records.description: One record per source that has its own source page.

id.description: A lowercase hyphenated id for the source, unique in the index. Source pages are addressed by it.

title.description: The source's title, such as the report name.

publisher.description: The organisation that published the source.

sourceType.description: What kind of source it is, such as Report.

published.description: The date the source was published, as YYYY-MM-DD.

reviewed.description: The date the record was last checked against the source, as YYYY-MM-DD.

url.description: The HTTPS address of the source. Every claim listed in supportedClaims must cite exactly this address.

scope.description: What the source covers, in a sentence or two.

method.description: How the source says it produced its figures, or null when it does not say.

limits.description: Plain statements of what this source does not support, such as which entities it leaves out.

supportedClaims.description: The catalogue facts that cite this source, each named by decision, option and criterion.

category.description: The id of the decision dataset the fact is in, such as banking.

entry.description: The code of the option the fact is about, within that dataset.

criterion.description: The criterion key the fact is recorded under, such as environment. That option's provenance for this criterion must cite the record's url.
